claims.text: Malignant (NCCN 2017): cytoreductive surgery when feasible, systemic chemo (commonly cyclophosphamide, vincristine, and dacarbazine or temozolomide), or 131I-MIBG.
claims.quote: According to the 2017 National Comprehensive Cancer Network guidelines, treatment options for malignant paraganglioma and pheochromocytoma include cytoreductive surgery when feasible, systemic chemotherapy (commonly consisting of cyclophosphamide, vincristine, and dacarbazine or temozolomide), or 131I-MIBG.
